name: orbit-workspace
title: Orbit Workspace
description: Search and create Orbit tasks and docs, read chat, save task views, and see your tasks in the menu bar.
author: Rob

preferences.name: instanceUrl
preferences.title: Orbit URL
preferences.description: The address of your Orbit, in Orbit Cloud or self-hosted.

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: API Token
preferences.description: Create it in Orbit under Settings → API tokens (it starts with orb_). For all features, give it Tasks: Write, Docs: Write and Chat: Read.

commands.name: search-tasks
commands.title: Search Tasks
commands.description: Search, filter and update your Orbit tasks.

commands.name: create-task
commands.title: Create Task
commands.description: Create a task in an Orbit project.

commands.name: create-doc
commands.title: Create Doc
commands.description: Create an Orbit doc from Markdown.

commands.name: chat
commands.title: Browse Chat
commands.description: Read Orbit channels, direct messages and threads.

commands.name: task-views
commands.title: Task Views
commands.description: Saved task filters, for example the open tasks of one project. Each view can become a quicklink.

commands.name: orbit-tasks-menu-bar
commands.title: Orbit Tasks
commands.description: Show your open Orbit tasks in the menu bar.

preferences.name: show
preferences.title: Show
preferences.description: Which open tasks the menu bar counts and lists.

tools.name: get-me
tools.title: Get Me
tools.description: Who the Orbit API token acts as (the current user), the workspace, the token's permissions and the Orbit URL.

tools.name: list-projects
tools.title: List Projects
tools.description: List the Orbit projects the token can use, with each project's key (for example DBM), its statuses in workflow order with their category, and its labels.

tools.name: list-members
tools.title: List Members
tools.description: List the members of the Orbit workspace, to choose assignees. Most tools also accept a member's name or "me" directly.

tools.name: list-task-views
tools.title: List Task Views
tools.description: List the task views the user saved in this extension. A view is a saved task filter (project, status, assignee, priority, label, text, sort). Pass a view's name to list-tasks as view.

tools.name: list-tasks
tools.title: List Tasks
tools.description: List Orbit tasks by project, status, assignee, priority, label, text or a saved task view. Returns open tasks unless state is done or all. For my tasks, use assignee "me"; for unassigned tasks, "none". Inputs take names (project DBM, status In Progress), not IDs. Supports nextCursor for more results.

tools.name: get-task
tools.title: Get Task
tools.description: Read one Orbit task by its identifier (for example DBM-12): description, status, priority, assignees, labels, due date and comments.

tools.name: create-task
tools.title: Create Task
tools.description: Create an Orbit task in a project (key, name or ID) with a title, and optionally a Markdown description, status, priority, assignees ("me" or names), labels and due date (ISO 8601).

tools.name: update-task
tools.title: Update Task
tools.description: Change an Orbit task by identifier (for example DBM-12): title, description, status (use "done" to close it), priority, assignees, labels or due date. Assignees and labels replace the existing ones.

tools.name: add-comment
tools.title: Add Comment
tools.description: Add a Markdown comment to an Orbit task by identifier (for example DBM-12).

tools.name: delete-task
tools.title: Delete Task
tools.description: Move an Orbit task and its sub-issues to the trash (restorable for 30 days). Only use when the user explicitly asks to delete or trash a task; to close a task, use update-task with status done.

tools.name: search-docs
tools.title: Search Docs
tools.description: Find Orbit docs by words in their title or their parent docs' titles. Orbit cannot search doc content. Returns doc IDs for get-doc.

tools.name: get-doc
tools.title: Get Doc
tools.description: Read an Orbit doc by ID or exact title. Returns its content as Markdown.

tools.name: create-doc
tools.title: Create Doc
tools.description: Create an Orbit doc from a title and Markdown, in the default teamspace, in the user's private space, or inside a parent doc.

tools.name: append-to-doc
tools.title: Append to Doc
tools.description: Add Markdown to the end of an Orbit doc (by ID or exact title) without changing the rest of it.

tools.name: list-conversations
tools.title: List Conversations
tools.description: List the Orbit chat channels and direct messages the user can read, most recently active first.

tools.name: get-messages
tools.title: Get Messages
tools.description: Read recent messages of an Orbit chat channel or direct message (by channel name, person's name or ID), or one thread. Chat is read-only: messages cannot be sent.

tools.name: search-messages
tools.title: Search Messages
tools.description: Search Orbit chat messages by words, in all conversations or one. Newest first, 20 per page, with nextCursor for older matches.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
